''See also: [[Dragon Army Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The dragons{{!}}Dragon Army was a specialized force of [[Travelers]] from the [[Territory]] of [[Valinhall]], originally established by [[Valin]]. He trained twelve humans to harness the powers of his [[Territory]], intending for them to serve as a powerful unit capable of overthrowing the tyranny of [[Damasca]]. Members of this group are distinguished from other [[Travelers]] by their ability to summon power into themselves to win battles rather than summoning it externally. Each original soldier was granted a [[Dragon's Fang]], which serves as a key to [[the House]] and was forged by the The Wanderer{{!}}Wanderer. The army's history is marked by tragedy; after [[Valin]]'s original mission, the group was slaughtered by their own master. This left only a few survivors, including [[Kai]]. Currently, the dragons{{!}}Dragon Army is considered broken and scattered. Of the thirteen original Fangs, only four remain in active use, while others are lost or intentionally sealed away. While the group once served as a powerful ally, some observers believe their primary function is to kill other [[Travelers]]. Despite its diminished state, the legacy of the army remains significant, with discussions regarding the redistribution of the remaining Fangs to worthy individuals.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Founded by [[Valin]], the dragons{{!}}Dragon Army was once a powerful ally that stood in opposition to [[Damasca]]. The group is composed of [[Valinhall Travelers]] who are notorious for murdering their own kind, including members such as [[Kai]] and Denner Weeks{{!}}Denner. Following the death of King [[Zakareth the Fifth]], the army was broken and currently finds itself in need of new [[blood]]. Because of their history, [[Naraka]] would find satisfaction in seeing the group finally receive what they deserve.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The dragons{{!}}Dragon Army consists of students such as [[Kai]] and [[Valin]], though many of its members struggle to pass the test of a specific room for months or even years. A significant portion of the group never succeeds in earning [[ghost armor]]. During the conflict, [[Indirial]] was assigned the task of disarming the army. Following the events where two members stepped into [[Valinhall]], the last remaining soldier of the dragons{{!}}Dragon Army abandoned her [[Territory]].}}
